AffixPrism rune choice recognition uses:

Tesseract .NET wrapper 5.2.0, Charles Weld and contributors
https://github.com/charlesw/tesseract
Apache License 2.0: Tesseract-wrapper-LICENSE.txt

Tesseract OCR 5.2 native libraries, provided by the wrapper package
https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tesseract
Apache License 2.0 (same license text as above).

English tessdata_fast model
https://github.com/tesseract-ocr/tessdata_fast
Revision 87416418657359cb625c412a48b6e1d6d41c29bd
Apache License 2.0: tessdata-LICENSE.txt

Leptonica 1.82 native libraries, provided by the wrapper package
https://github.com/DanBloomberg/leptonica
License and attribution: Leptonica-LICENSE.txt

The rune-choice workflow was inspired by RuneHelper, Danila Chernykh:
https://github.com/Denzeriko/RuneHelper (MIT).
RuneHelper's code and sample image are not incorporated in the published
application. The smoke test generates its own OCR text image.
